ja: なんてこと…

key: CAIN: ...But we're not just gonna let this happen.
en: CAIN: ...But we're not just gonna let this happen.
ja: カイン: …でも、このまま黙って見てるつもりはないよ。

key: SHELLY: What-- what do you mean?
en: SHELLY: What-- what do you mean?
ja: シェリー: ど、どういうこと?

key: CAIN: Well, we can't just leave her in the clutches of Dr. Butt.
en: CAIN: Well, we can't just leave her in the clutches of Dr. Butt.
ja: カイン: つまりさ、あのケツ博士の手に彼女を放っておくわけにはいかないってこと。

key: SHELLY: But if we do anything, won't we get in trouble?
en: SHELLY: But if we do anything, won't we get in trouble?
ja: シェリー: でも何かしたら、わたしたち面倒なことにならない?

key: CAIN: Yeah, you're right.
en: CAIN: Yeah, you're right.
ja: カイン: うん、その通り。

key: We could maybe be arrested, maybe put in jail...
en: We could maybe be arrested, maybe put in jail...
ja: 逮捕されるかもしれないし、独房に入れられるかもしれない…

key: Big trouble.
en: Big trouble.
ja: 大問題だ。

key: But Heather's already in trouble.
en: But Heather's already in trouble.
ja: でもヘザーはもう困った状況にいる。

key: So I'm gonna take that chance.
en: So I'm gonna take that chance.
ja: だから俺はその賭けに出るよ。

key: The law doesn't know what's best for her.
en: The law doesn't know what's best for her.
ja: 法律なんて、あの子にとって何が一番いいかわかっちゃいない。

key: I believe her when she says she's doing fine on her own.
en: I believe her when she says she's doing fine on her own.
ja: ひとりでちゃんとやってるって言う彼女の言葉を、俺は信じる。

key: Living day to day is hard, but it's not as hard as people make it out to be.
en: Living day to day is hard, but it's not as hard as people make it out to be.
ja: その日暮らしは大変だけど、みんなが言うほど大変なもんじゃない。

key: Not when you've got good friends around.
en: Not when you've got good friends around.
ja: いい友達が周りにいればね。

key: And she made it pretty clear she doesn't wanna be there.
en: And she made it pretty clear she doesn't wanna be there.
ja: それに、あそこにいたくないってはっきり言ってたじゃん。

key: So she has to deal and suck it up, just because a few legal documents and some old guy said so?
en: So she has to deal and suck it up, just because a few legal documents and some old guy said so?
ja: だからって、書類何枚かと年寄りひとりに言われただけで、我慢して受け入れなきゃいけないのか?

key: I don't think so.
en: I don't think so.
ja: そうは思わないね。

key: He dragged her in there all but kicking and screaming.
en: He dragged her in there all but kicking and screaming.
ja: あいつは、彼女が抵抗して暴れるのを無理やり連れていったんだ。

key: We can pull her out.
en: We can pull her out.
ja: 俺たちなら助け出せる。

key: \PN, you with me?
en: \PN, you with me?
ja: \PN、一緒にやってくれる?

key: CAIN: I knew you'd see it my way~
en: CAIN: I knew you'd see it my way~
ja: カイン: 君ならわかってくれると思ってたよ~

key: CAIN: I know not everyone's as comfortable skirting the law as I've been.
en: CAIN: I know not everyone's as comfortable skirting the law as I've been.
ja: カイン: 誰もが俺みたいに法律すれすれに慣れてるわけじゃないってわかってる。

key: But if you'll allow it, I'm gonna ask for your help this time anyway.
en: But if you'll allow it, I'm gonna ask for your help this time anyway.
ja: でも良かったら、今回もやっぱり君の力を借りたいんだ。

key: Don't worry; if anything happens, I'll take 100% of the blame.
en: Don't worry; if anything happens, I'll take 100% of the blame.
ja: 心配しないで。何かあったら、責任は俺が全部かぶるから。

key: SHELLY: ...Okay, let's do it.
en: SHELLY: ...Okay, let's do it.
ja: シェリー: …わかった、やろう。

key: CAIN: Huh, you're coming too?
en: CAIN: Huh, you're coming too?
ja: カイン: え、君も来るの?

key: U-um, if that's okay...
en: U-um, if that's okay...
ja: あ、あの、いいなら…

key: CAIN: Well, none of this is okay, depending on who you ask.
en: CAIN: Well, none of this is okay, depending on who you ask.
ja: カイン: まあ、誰に聞くかによっちゃ、そもそも何にもいいことなんてないけどね。

key: But I'm happy to have you; the more the merrier~
en: But I'm happy to have you; the more the merrier~
ja: でも来てくれるのはうれしいよ、多いほうが楽しいしね~

key: SHELLY: She's my friend, and--
en: SHELLY: She's my friend, and--
ja: シェリー: 彼女はわたしの友達だし――

key: I was the one who called her here, and--
en: I was the one who called her here, and--
ja: ここに呼んだのはわたしだし――

key: The doctor only came here for me--
en: The doctor only came here for me--
ja: あの医者だって、わたしのために来ただけだし――

key: It's my fault that this even happened, so...
en: It's my fault that this even happened, so...
ja: こうなったのはわたしのせいなんだもの…

key: So, um...
en: So, um...
ja: だから、その…

key: We'll d-do our best to make it right, maybe!?
en: We'll d-do our best to make it right, maybe!?
ja: ちゃ、ちゃんと取り返すよう、頑張るから!?

key: CAIN: You got it.
en: CAIN: You got it.
ja: カイン: よし、決まりだね。

key: Let's not keep her waiting!
en: Let's not keep her waiting!
ja: 彼女を待たせないようにしよう!

key: SHELLY: R-right!
en: SHELLY: R-right!
ja: シェリー: う、うん!

key: CAIN: Take your time, take your time.
en: CAIN: Take your time, take your time.
ja: カイン: ゆっくりでいいよ、ゆっくりで。

key: I'll always wait for you, \PN~
en: I'll always wait for you, \PN~
ja: 俺はいつだって君を待ってるからね、\PN~

key: VICTORIA: Uh, hey, that was--
en: VICTORIA: Uh, hey, that was--
ja: ヴィクトリア: ねえ、今のは――

key: CAL: Fucking awful of me, I know.
en: CAL: Fucking awful of me, I know.
ja: キャル: 最低なことしたって、わかってる。

key: I said I wouldn't be like him, and yet...
en: I said I wouldn't be like him, and yet...
ja: あんな風にはならないって言ってたのに、それなのに…

key: CAL: I never wanted to hurt her...
en: CAL: I never wanted to hurt her...
ja: キャル: 彼女を傷つけたくなんてなかった…

key: Why the FUCK did I--
en: Why the FUCK did I--
ja: なんで俺は――くそっ――

key: VICTORIA: Hey.
en: VICTORIA: Hey.
ja: ヴィクトリア: ねえ。

key: CAL: Just leave me alone!
en: CAL: Just leave me alone!
ja: キャル: 放っといてくれ!

key: Someone like me doesn't deserve to be treated with kindness.
en: Someone like me doesn't deserve to be treated with kindness.
ja: 俺みたいな奴は、優しくされる資格なんてない。

key: VICTORIA: I don't think that's going to help.
en: VICTORIA: I don't think that's going to help.
ja: ヴィクトリア: それで何かが良くなるとは思えないわね。

key: CAL: There's nothing to help.
en: CAL: There's nothing to help.
ja: キャル: 良くなるものなんて何もないんだよ。

key: I fucked up, and I can't take it back.
en: I fucked up, and I can't take it back.
ja: やらかしちまった、もう取り消せない。

key: That's that.
en: That's that.
ja: それだけのことだ。

key: The best thing I can do now is to just go away.
en: The best thing I can do now is to just go away.
ja: 今の俺にできる一番いいことは、消えることだけだ。

key: VICTORIA: ...
en: VICTORIA: ...
ja: ヴィクトリア: …

key: VICTORIA: What if I told you there was a place you could go, far away from here, where you could learn to control your emotions?
en: VICTORIA: What if I told you there was a place you could go, far away from here, where you could learn to control your emotions?
ja: ヴィクトリア: もしここから遠く離れた場所で、感情のコントロールを学べる場所があるって言ったらどうする?

key: Where?
en: Where?
ja: どこに?

key: VICTORIA: Have you heard of Apophyll Academy?
en: VICTORIA: Have you heard of Apophyll Academy?
ja: ヴィクトリア: アポフィルアカデミーって聞いたことある?

key: CAL: No.
en: CAL: No.
ja: キャル: いや。

key: VICTORIA: It's just across Azurine Lake.
en: VICTORIA: It's just across Azurine Lake.
ja: ヴィクトリア: アズリン湖のちょうど向こう側にあるの。

key: Actually, it's where I live.
en: Actually, it's where I live.
ja: 実は、わたしが暮らしている場所よ。

key: Our sensei, Kiki, would be able to help you, no doubt about it.
en: Our sensei, Kiki, would be able to help you, no doubt about it.
ja: わたしたちの師範のキキなら、あなたを助けてくれるはず、間違いなくね。

key: I can take you there, if you'd like.
en: I can take you there, if you'd like.
ja: よかったら、そこに連れていってあげる。

key: CAL: You think you can even help someone like me?
en: CAL: You think you can even help someone like me?
ja: キャル: 俺みたいな奴でも助けられると思ってんのか?

key: VICTORIA: I think it would be a mistake not to try.
en: VICTORIA: I think it would be a mistake not to try.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 試さない方が間違いだと思うわ。

key: CAL: Fine.
en: CAL: Fine.
ja: キャル: わかったよ。

key: Lead the way.
en: Lead the way.
ja: 案内してくれ。

key: VICTORIA: With pleasure!
en: VICTORIA: With pleasure!
ja: ヴィクトリア: 喜んで!

key: CAIN: Uh, did something happen...?
en: CAIN: Uh, did something happen...?
ja: カイン: あれ、何かあったの…?

key: CAIN: Oh, you got your gym badge!
en: CAIN: Oh, you got your gym badge!
ja: カイン: おっ、ジムバッジ手に入れたんだね!

key: Congrats~
en: Congrats~
ja: おめでとう~

key: Is Shelly holding up?
en: Is Shelly holding up?
ja: シェリーは大丈夫そう?

key: I was hoping to face her too, but I understand if she needs more time...
en: I was hoping to face her too, but I understand if she needs more time...
ja: 俺も彼女と戦いたいと思ってたけど、まだ時間が必要ならわかるよ…

key: Hey, would you be up for a match?
en: Hey, would you be up for a match?
ja: ねえ、俺と一戦どう?

key: I'd love to feel your strength for myself~
en: I'd love to feel your strength for myself~
ja: 君の強さ、自分自身で感じてみたいんだよね~

key: Just to see how I measure up...
en: Just to see how I measure up...
ja: どれくらい俺が通用するか見たいだけさ…

key: Before I go challenging her, I mean!
en: Before I go challenging her, I mean!
ja: 彼女に挑む前にってことだけどね!

key: Besides, I saw that doctor go in there. It'll be a good way to pass the time until she's ready.
en: Besides, I saw that doctor go in there. It'll be a good way to pass the time until she's ready.
ja: それに、あの医者が中に入っていくのを見たしね。彼女の準備ができるまで、時間つぶしにちょうどいいよ。

key: Lemme heal your team, and then talk to me when you're up for it?
en: Lemme heal your team, and then talk to me when you're up for it?
ja: パーティ回復してあげるから、準備できたら声かけて?

key: SHELLY: It's locked...
en: SHELLY: It's locked...
ja: シェリー: 鍵がかかってるわ…

key: U-um, I think?
en: U-um, I think?
ja: あ、あの、たぶん?

key: You could try it yourself to be sure...
en: You could try it yourself to be sure...
ja: 確かめたいなら自分で試してみて…

key: CAIN: Door's locked.
en: CAIN: Door's locked.
ja: カイン: ドアに鍵がかかってる。

key: Geez, I thought we would at least be able to get in!
en: Geez, I thought we would at least be able to get in!
ja: まったく、少なくとも入れるとは思ってたのに!

key: Maybe if we take a screwdriver to the hinges...
en: Maybe if we take a screwdriver to the hinges...
ja: チョウ番にドライバーでも使えば…

en: ARCHER: I'm gonna leave dealing with her to you, \PN.
ja: アーチャー: 彼女への対処は君に任せるとしよう、\PN。

key: I'll stand guard and make sure no one interferes.
en: I'll stand guard and make sure no one interferes.
ja: 私は見張りに立ち、誰にも邪魔をさせないようにする。

key: MAXWELL: The floor is yours, \PN.
en: MAXWELL: The floor is yours, \PN.
ja: マクスウェル: 舞台は君のものだ、\PN。

ja: 「栄光」ってのがどういうものか、見せつけてやれよ。

en: I'll make sure no one gets in your way.
ja: 誰にも邪魔させないようにしとくからな。

key: ARCHER: Well done.
en: ARCHER: Well done.
ja: アーチャー: 見事だ。

key: I do believe that will be sufficient to see her excised from 7th Street.
en: I do believe that will be sufficient to see her excised from 7th Street.
ja: これで彼女を7番街から排除するには十分だろう。

key: I won't keep you any longer, but for one gift, from me to you.
en: I won't keep you any longer, but for one gift, from me to you.
ja: これ以上引き止めはしないが、私から君へ、ひとつ贈り物を。

key: A member of the Aqua Gang should naturally find this useful.
en: A member of the Aqua Gang should naturally find this useful.
ja: アクアギャングの一員なら、当然これが役に立つだろう。

key: ARCHER: I'll see you around.
en: ARCHER: I'll see you around.
ja: アーチャー: また会おう。

key: MAXWELL: That?
en: MAXWELL: That?
ja: マクスウェル: あれか?

key: Was hilarious.
en: Was hilarious.
ja: 最高に笑えたな。

key: Good show!
en: Good show!
ja: 見事なもんだ!

key: I bet she won't be showing her face down there for quite some time.
en: I bet she won't be showing her face down there for quite some time.

key: Hey, thanks for your help.

key: I have one more gift for you.
en: I have one more gift for you.
ja: もうひとつ贈り物があるんだ。

key: MAXWELL: Not bad for a group like ours, yeah?
en: MAXWELL: Not bad for a group like ours, yeah?
ja: マクスウェル: 俺たちみたいな集まりにしちゃ、悪くないだろ?

key: I'll see you on the flip-side.
en: I'll see you on the flip-side.
ja: またどこかで会おう。

key: For glory, baby!
en: For glory, baby!
ja: 栄光のためにな!

key: I don't suggest you go much further ahead.
en: I don't suggest you go much further ahead.
ja: これ以上先に進むのはおすすめしないぞ。

key: It's for your own good.
en: It's for your own good.
ja: マレー: あんたのためを思って言ってるんだ。

key: I can only hope they get the poor soul cleaned up soon.
en: I can only hope they get the poor soul cleaned up soon.
ja: あの気の毒な人、早く片付けてもらえるといいんだが。

key: Hey, did you know?
en: Hey, did you know?
ja: ねえ、知ってた?

key: The winds in Reborn are sometimes so strong that they allow Flying-type Pokémon to ignore their weaknesses!
en: The winds in Reborn are sometimes so strong that they allow Flying-type Pokémon to ignore their weaknesses!
ja: リボーンの風は時々ものすごく強くて、ひこうタイプのポケモンが弱点を無視できるくらいなのよ!

key: This would be such a great view of the city...
en: This would be such a great view of the city...

key: I only wish that the rest of it was as clean as Lapis.

en: This be our territory. Back off, bro.
ja: ここは俺たちの縄張りだ。下がれよ、兄弟。

key: ...Yeah, bro.
en: ...Yeah, bro.
ja: トニー: …ああ、兄弟。

key: Hmph. I GUESS you can pass.
en: Hmph. I GUESS you can pass.
ja: ふん。まあ通ってもいいけどな。

key: You must be new around here.
en: You must be new around here.
ja: このあたりは初めてなんだろ。

key: How do I know?
en: How do I know?
ja: なんでわかるかって?

key: You're dressed too good to be in this part of town.
en: You're dressed too good to be in this part of town.
ja: こんな場所にしちゃ、身なりが良すぎるからだよ。

key: You battle too good for this part too...
en: You battle too good for this part too...
ja: マーフィー: バトルの腕も、こんな場所にはもったいないくらいだ…

key: Watch yourself now.
en: Watch yourself now.

key: This neighborhood's ours though, believe it.
